profile.headline: SWE II @ Microsoft
profile.summary: Software engineer specializing in large-scale cloud infrastructure, distributed systems reliability, and platform engineering. Experienced in driving platform-wide reliability, security, automation, and infrastructure optimization initiatives across production environments, including large-scale migrations, deployment systems, virtualization platforms, and SRE tooling. Delivered significant operational and infrastructure cost savings, reduced recurring production incidents to near zero, and led security/compliance improvements for regulated environments. Passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges involving scalability, rollout safety, performance, and operational excellence.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led reliability and stability improvements for large-scale cloud infrastructure services, reducing recurring live-site incidents from multiple weekly occurrences to near zero through systemic fixes and rollout safety enhancements.
• Drove large-scale infrastructure migrations and deployment optimizations, contributing to cost savings scaling from ~$2.4M/month to ~$9M/month.
• Reduced infrastructure waste by ~40%, eliminated ~$1.25M/month in overprovisioning, and delivered automation improvements contributing to ~$16M/year in operational savings.
• Improved infrastructure provisioning and deployment performance by optimizing disk architecture and automation workflows, reducing critical execution times from ~32 minutes to ~10 minutes (~69% reduction) while significantly improving cold start latency.
• Led security and compliance initiatives including managed identity migration, automated certificate rotation, secure data access controls, worker sanitization, single-tenancy isolation enforcement, and regulated environment readiness.
• Built AI-driven SRE automation tooling for deployment validation, compliance enforcement, quota management, and automated mitigation workflows.
• Collaborated across infrastructure, virtualization, and deployment engineering teams to deliver platform-wide reliability, scalability, and operational improvements.
• Progressed into end-to-end technical ownership of critical platform areas spanning reliability, deployment systems, security, automation, and virtualization infrastructure.
positions.insights: Distributed Systems, Platform as a Service (PAAS) and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced data protection across internal software tool by encrypting keys and secrets using Azure Key Vault
• Standardized and enhanced logging, cross-system dependency tracking using Azure Application Insights
• Built Azure Data Factory data pipeline to ingest and process data from various sources
• Managed team of ten software engineer for evaluating, optimizing clients' business performance by conducting data modeling and visualization using Power BI
positions.insights: Microsoft Azure, Cloud Computing and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Maintained and developed a ASP.NET MVC Core web application.
• Designed and implemented a customizable template for all company’s automatic emails.
• Implemented error handlers for the application.
• Developed searching feature and applying process for young athletes to join available sport teams within area. 
• Implemented sport fields/facilities availability management feature based on time-slot structure, significantly improve user experience.
positions.insights: Software Design, Full-Stack Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Investigated and conducted a new system architecture’s specification document for improving scalability.
• Developed a GraphQL server handling back-end logic and communication with Cloud Firestore database.
• Implemented SMS, email, and social media sharing features.
• Developed a React photo gallery web app for managing, sharing, up and downloading photos.
• Implemented filtering and searching logic for the web app, boosting user experience.

projects.title: 'SU'perheroes
projects.description:
• Moderated sized robust cross-platform mobile game using Xamarin in .NET framework
• SUperheroes is a turn-based game where players can construct a team from a list of provided heroes to fight against monsters in order to achieve the highest score.

projects.title: DuaLeo's Bot
projects.description:
- A simple to use music bot running on the Discord platform. Supports playing music from YouTube, Soundcloud, and Spotify.
- Include other interesting features, specially made to create a positive vibe in our private gaming server.
- Implementation mainly uses JavaScript which interacts with Discord API for controlling the bot on the platform.
